record.field: Sales board for quotations and orders: quotation and order counts, untaxed totals, average order value, confirmation rate, late deliveries, to-invoice backlog, amount trends, top customers, status and salesperson breakdowns, and a recent orders list. Late deliveries only compare the commitment date with today, since the delivery status lives in Sales Stock. Requires Sales.
